Bug_Title: Exceptions should not be created without being thrown
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by creating an IllegalArgumentException without throwing it when the condition x < 0 is met.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case testShowBugWithNegativeValue triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a negative value (-1), which creates an IllegalArgumentException without throwing it.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that all tests passed without any exceptions being thrown or errors occurring, indicating that the bug did not trigger any failures in the test suite.
